narrative: A combined downside (Euribor −50 bp, markets −15%) takes comparable CIR to 67.2% and ROE to 10.7%. Credit stress at 40 bps costs about €15M more than a normal year but leaves CET1 at 12.3%. The upside — Euribor +25 bp as hedges roll, AUM +5%, the MOPS price-list change and the cost levers — brings CIR to 58.7% and ROE to 14.9% (13.3% with normal credit losses). One driver model serves budget and ICAAP.

signals.title: Path to CIR < 60%: +€11.3M income, −€6.5M cost
signals.excerpt: AUM +5%, Euribor +25 bp as hedges roll, MOPS price list +3%, Oracle decommission, purchased services, 15 open positions → CIR 58.7%, ROE 14.9% (13.3% with normal credit losses).
